name: Lord Howe woodhen
desc: A flightless rail that eats worms, crustaceans and fruit, and sometimes shearwater eggs. Near 20 birds in the 1970s, it has recovered strongly after feral animals were removed.
about: The Lord Howe woodhen also known as the Lord Howe Island woodhen, Lord Howe wood rail, Lord Howe rail or Lord Howe Island rail, is a flightless bird of the rail family, Rallidae.
